# Infra Grub Rules

Apply the following infra grub rules guidance to the code or configuration you are changing. Check the stated preconditions and preserve behavior outside the authorized scope.

## Required checks

- Follow the workflow in `$CODEX_HOME/plugins/system-infra/skills/infra-grub/SKILL.md`.
- Prefer deterministic scripts in `$CODEX_HOME/plugins/system-infra/skills/infra-grub/scripts/`.
- Use references in `$CODEX_HOME/plugins/system-infra/skills/infra-grub/references/` for factual guidance.
